title: Slimline hosted API getting-started screenshot pack (compact flows & localized code toggles)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, mobile-friendly screenshot and asset pack for the Hosted API getting-started experience. Focus areas: (1) model selector in a slimlined layout that surfaces family, latency tier, and cost hints; (2) an inline request-builder flow that demonstrates streaming vs non-streaming and shows parameter sliders for temperature/top_p; (3) localized code snippet toggles (Python, Node, curl) with copy-to-clipboard affordances and short inline comments; (4) accessibility and contrast variants; (5) a short animated GIF that shows 'first request' flow from model pick to response. Deliverables: high-res PNGs (desktop and mobile), an animated GIF for the request flow, a Figma file with components, and ready-to-publish code tiles for docs. Coordinate with PM and ENG for final wording and with i18n for Spanish/French snippet translations.
